6. **A flaw in our own D0 found on the way:** our "aims at me" test is instantaneous (12 degrees, 1 s memory), so a
   proj1 torso sweep crossing us inside 160 m flags it hostile about 42% of the time (model). The proj1 code family
   may hold four of the top seven seats. Fix proposal in section 5 (K2).

## 3. How a squad profile changes behaviour

A profile is a named set of overrides applied at start-up. It touches only practice-only knobs, so the
free-for-all play is identical under every profile. "Practice" means: past 20 s of match time and no death seen
that the bot did not cause. The knobs, in our words:

| Knob | Off (base) | What it does when set |
|---|---|---|
| attack on sight | off | after the gate, any mech within the attack radius (160 m) is a target while own health is above the attack health (60%); with health above 80% it also walks toward any mech seen in the last 20 s |
| farm gate | off | until N cubes or T seconds, a mech is a target only if it damaged us in the last 4 s **and** is within 100 m; no hunting |
| fixed range | off (damage model) | against every mech (not drones) hold this distance instead of the damage-model choice |
| retreat threshold | 35% | low-health break-off level (0 = never) |
| berserk | off | always take the fight with the current target |
| laser-pair | off | trade the gun for lightning once it holds a laser |
| damage-first upgrades | off | laser damage, gun damage, gun rate, laser charge, then plating, armour |
| laser caution / far loot | caution off, loot near-only | the two "peek" and "far" profiles switch them the other way |

### 3.1 f75kite in numbers (practice posture)

- **0-75 s (or until 10 cubes; 10 is rarely reached that early): farm gate.** It starts no fight and answers only a
  mech that hit it in the last 4 s from inside 100 m. The practice hunter fights at 100-150 m, so in practice it
  simply does not fight the early hunter: it keeps farming above 70% health, moves to a hidden spot when hurt
  (below 70% with damage in the last 40 s) and latches a retreat below 35% while under fire.
- **After the gate: attack on sight** at more than 60% health against any mech within 160 m, and walk toward any
  mech seen in the last 20 s at more than 80% health. Target score: line of fire, hit us in the last 4 s, current
  target, low health and nearness.
- **Range: 170 m against every mech**, whatever it holds (gun only included). The mover loses 1.2 points per metre
  off 170 m (against a small strafe bonus), so the hold is tight. It **boosts away whenever the target is more
  than 25 m inside 170 m (under 145 m) and energy is above 30**. With the target out of sight it walks to the last
  known position until within about 100 m (0.6 of the hold). Drones still get the damage-model range.
- Fight-or-break test evaluated at 170 m: fight while its time to kill the target is shorter than the target's
  time to kill it (or the damage advantage is clearly positive); 1.5 times margin with two or more hostiles.
- Retreat below 35% under fire unless the kill is under 1.6 s away; back in at 80% (or 55% when nobody is in view
  and no hit for 6 s). Holds fire while hidden and unhit so repair can start (5 s, then 45 health a second).
- No laser-timing caution and no "much stronger mech" avoidance in practice.
- Loot near-only: every metre costs about twice the free-for-all rate, so it walks at most about 85 m for a cube,
  80 m for a crate (above 45% health), 130 m for a drone (above 60% health, nobody in view), 200 m for a laser.
- Keeps the gun; second slot laser, else lightning; never a mortar. Upgrades: plating, armour, laser damage,
  laser charge, repair, gun damage, gun rate, lightning efficiency, then the rest.

## 4. Why f75kite scores 5.60 (numbers)

- **Score arithmetic.** Practice score = kills before death over 48 seeded matches: 4.96 = 238, 5.19 = 249,
  5.31 = 255, 5.42 = 260, 5.60 = 269. The whole ladder from attack-on-sight to f75kite is +31 kills (+0.65), far
  outside the 0.27-0.33 re-roll noise (13-16 kills); the last step alone (+9) is not.
- **The gate (+22 kills from 20 s to 75 s, peak at 75 s; 130 s gives back 15).** Not fighting the first hunter at
  100-150 m while there are free crates and drones converts early health into cubes, and cubes into plating,
  armour and laser upgrades before the multi-hunter phase.
- **The kite (+9 kills, inside noise).** Its own damage model prefers 100 m against a gun + laser mech (our
  restatement: advantage 47 at 100 m, 33 at 170 m) because it assumes its dodging holds enemy guns to about 15% at
  100 m. Live measurements of house-bot guns say otherwise: 31% (S05) to 57% (D1) at 100-126 m, against 12-23% at
  about 170 m, where a round flies 0.67 s (0.40 s at 100 m) and a strafing target has changed velocity. House gun
  sustained output is 102 a second if every round lands, so incoming gun damage falls from 32-58 to 12-24 a second.
  With both lasers at up to 131 a second, 1,400 health lasts 7.4-8.6 s at about 100-115 m and 9.0-9.8 s at 170 m:
  +1.2-1.4 s (+15-20%) per hunter. A measured lead aim (another team's, S05) landed about 65% on house bots at all
  ranges, because they walk steadily and hop on ballistic arcs, so a good gun loses little at 170 m. The laser is hitscan to
  280 m and unaffected. Net: duels get longer for the hunter, not for it. [model on [S] inputs]
- **Why the earlier kite profiles lost.** kite150 and kite200 (4.1-4.4) were bundled with "always fight" and
  "never retreat" on the old farming code. f75kite keeps the 35% retreat and the gate. The clean one-change result
  is positive.

What it teaches in one line: **gate the first 75 s, then fight on sight from 150-170 m with gun + laser, keep the 35%
retreat, loot only what is near.** Doctrine V4 already has the kite and the retreat; it lacks the long gate.

## 6. Limitations of the 5.60 build (each checked in the source)

Practice (exploitable only by house bots, listed for completeness): it ignores a hunter shooting from beyond 100 m
for the first 75 s; it holds 170 m even with only a gun; a mech beyond 160 m that has not hit it is no target, so
it hovers at the 160-170 m edge while hunting.

Free-for-all:
1. **Opening blind spot (this build and every farm-gate build before 07:19):** the farm gate also runs in a real
   free-for-all until the first death it did not cause. Until then it fires only at a mech that damaged it from
   inside 100 m in the last 4 s: no reply to fire from 100-280 m, no reply to aim or closeness, no hunting. It keeps
   farming down to 70% health, then hides; it latches a retreat at 35%. First deaths in the 11 recorded showdowns
   came at 6-17 s.
2. Hostile-only afterwards: it opens fire only on a mech that kept its torso on it (about 7 degrees beyond 50 m,
   wider closer) for 0.6 s with a line inside 260 m (0.2 s while that mech charges a laser), came within 30 m,
   damaged it (hostile for 25 s), or is under 40% within 150 m while it is above 60%.
3. Blind arcs: 120-degree wedge, idle sweep of 109 degrees either side of its walking direction every 5.7 s; a
   22-degree cone behind its walk is never looked at beyond 45 m; with a hidden target its torso stays on that
   bearing; it turns to damage for 2.5 s and to near sounds for 1.5 s. A drone that hit it in the last 3 s pulls
   its torso around when it has no mech to shoot.
4. Unseen attackers are never shot back; it moves to cover.
5. Retreat watches only its last attacker, holds fire while unhit, needs about 19 s from 35% to 80%.
6. Laser caution is mechanical: hidden while any known laser could fire within 0.85 s; steps out in the ~1.5 s
   after a beam; believes a 3-cube carrier charges 40% faster.
7. "Much stronger" avoidance (more than 2 alive): drops all loot within 160 m of a mech whose health times damage
   rate is over twice its own within 300 m, breaks the line, boosts inside 170 m. Off with two left.
8. Final duel: holds its computed range (about 55 m against laser + lightning) and trades even when out-cubed.
9. Supply drops: walks to any drop reachable within 25 s of landing, even a held one; stands inside 2 m for 4 s.
10. Quiet-final misread: if nobody has died by 20 s it plays the practice posture of section 3.1.
11. Never laser + lightning, never jumps in fights, cover search is random sampling (re-drawn every 2.5 s).

## 7. Free-for-all behaviour

### 7.1 The 5.60 build (its default final entry)

Same code as the TigerTown27 study (section 2 there), confirmed unchanged except the biter rule and the gate quirk:
two postures from one detector (practice only when nobody else has died and past 20 s); hostile-only targeting (6.2);
fight test by time to kill at the held range (1.5x with two or more hostiles); range by its damage model: about
100 m against gun or gun + laser, about 55 m against laser + lightning, 28-30 m only with its own lightning, at
least 54 m from lightning carriers it is not brawling, no laser charge against a lightning carrier closing faster
than 4 m/s at 46-68 m; retreat 35% -> 80%; avoid mechs rated twice as strong; laser caution; economy: cube 110,
crate 105, drone 170 (remembered for 2 minutes), second weapon about 200, laser at least 270, drop 170 (60 if held),
minus 0.6 per metre, so up to about 280 m for a drone and 450 m for a laser; zone: arrives 6 s before the shrink
ends; aiming with five motion guesses and a muzzle-line check, laser at full charge only; bullet-search dodge with
strafe reversals every 0.35-0.9 s. Recorded free-for-all of the code family (older builds, TigerTown27): 9.9 points a
match, 7 of 8 deaths by laser at 53-195 m, hit first in 7 of 10 openings.

### 7.2 If 2696 posts a newer best (builds from 07:05 on)

- Opening blind spot gone (gate only in practice after 20 s): aim and closeness count from second 0.
- Avoids any mech rated above 0.85 times its own strength within 300 m (unless two are left): it gives way to
  almost every equal mech, leaves loot near it and boosts out of its line inside 170 m.
- Walks to deaths it hears in the near or mid band (estimated 35 m / 105 m along the bearing, or the spot of a mech
  it saw there) to pick up the dropped cubes; such a spot is worth about as much as a drone or more, so it will walk
  a few hundred metres to it when nothing better is near, and gives up after 45 s.
- Without a laser: climbs roofs for a weapon unless a mech within 110 m is hostile or has a line on it, and walks to
  unseen ground when nobody is near.

## 8. Observable signatures (what an anonymous opponent sees)

- **Spawn:** one full torso turn at 4 rad/s in the first 1.7 s, then the 109-degree sweep about its walking
  direction, 5.7 s per cycle, pitch level.
- **Weapons:** gun always; gun + lightning only until a laser turns up; never a mortar, never laser + lightning.
  Max health steps up 15% with its first upgrade (plating), then armour.
- **Range held:** about 100 m from gun or gun + laser mechs, about 55 m from laser + lightning, 28-30 m when it
  holds lightning; in the quiet-final misread, 170 m with a boost back whenever we come inside 145 m.
- **Speed / boost:** walks at 11.7 m/s while travelling; boosts (19.5 m/s) when hit and breaking off (energy > 12),
  to reopen range (energy > 30), when late for the zone (straight, no strafing) and when fleeing a stronger mech
  inside 170 m; never jumps in a fight. Recorded boost share 8-31% of its life.
- **Farming:** stops 14-15 m from a crate and shoots down at it; spends a full laser charge on a crate when no mech
  has been in view for 4 s; walks back to drones' home areas; reloads only at 4 rounds or fewer; picks cubes and
  crates within 28-35 m while retreating.
- **Reaction to fire:** before the first death anywhere: none from beyond 100 m (keeps farming to 70%, then hides).
  After: the shooter is hostile for 25 s, the torso snaps to the damage bearing for 2.5 s, it fights at its range
  if the time-to-kill test passes, else breaks the line; at 35% it turns and boosts to cover and stops shooting;
  an unseen shooter only makes it move. Against a ready laser it stays behind its corner and steps out right after
  the beam.

## 9. Counters (free-for-all; every one also fits the other proj1 copies)

The counter module acts only after our latch (3 foreign deaths, median 18 s). K1 and K2 concern the opening, which
runs on D0 and SQUAD logic, so they are rules for D0, not for the module.

**K1. Opening amnesty: loot near it, never inside 100 m.**
Trigger: nobody has died yet (alive 16); a gun or gun + laser mech at 100-200 m that has not damaged us; stronger
with the spawn turn and sweep. Action: nothing new in code beyond K2: keep farming and taking weapons in its view,
pass it at 100 m or more, do not damage it. Exploited: limitation 1 (answers only hits from inside 100 m until the
first death). Gain: uncontested opening loot (first laser, 1-3 cubes) for the 6-17 s before the first death, with
no fire from up to four finalists. Backfire: a look-alike that shoots on sight costs at most one hit before D0
answers. The window closes at the first death; newer builds (7.2) do not have it.

**K2. Do not take its sweep for hostility (fix to our D0).**
Trigger: our "aims at me" test sees a torso cross us inside 160 m. Action: count aim-hostility only after 3
consecutive decisions (0.3 s) within 12 degrees, or immediately when the mech's laser is charging aimed at us;
damage-hostility stays immediate. Exploited: none; it removes our false positive (an idle proj1 sweep crossing us is
flagged about 42% of the time within 160 m, 2 crossings per 5.7 s cycle, `tools/top10/t2696_sweep_flag.py`).
Gain: no self-started duels in the opening with the strongest free-for-all family (9.9 points a match recorded),
whose first hit back makes it hostile for 25 s. Backfire: 0.2-0.3 s later reaction to a real aimer that has not
fired yet (house hunters are caught by the damage rule at their first hit). It changes SQUAD play: one-change
submission required, D0 bit-identity rules apply.

**K3. Second-attacker finish on its retreat** (earlier C1, confirmed in this build).
Trigger: after the latch, a gun + laser mech at 40% or less that turns away boosting or stands behind cover with a
fixed torso. Action: approach to 60-150 m from at least 60 degrees off its torso, stay beyond 45 m, charge 0.3 rad
off-axis, swing on and release, gun follows, second beam 2.4 s later; stop if it reaches cover or a third mech aims
at us for 0.3 s. Exploited: limitation 5. Gain: 315-472 per beam against 490 health or less: a kill and its cubes
in most attempts. Backfire: a bot that shoots while retreating returns fire; bounded by D3's break-off.

**K4. Beam only in its disarmed or blind windows, from a corner** (earlier C3).
Trigger: it is a target (hostile to us, or K3) and one of: its laser fired or stopped charging in the last 1.5 s;
its torso 60 degrees or more off us beyond 45 m; it stands 14-15 m from a crate pitched down; it runs late for the
zone. Action: off-axis charge behind our corner, swing, release, back in cover within 0.8 s. Never shoot it while
it sits behind a corner facing us with our laser ready (it steps out the moment we discharge). Exploited:
limitations 3 and 6. Gain: 315-472 per beam with no beam back for 2.4 s. Backfire: none beyond a normal peek.

**K5. Make it give way: show strength near the loot we want** (earlier C6, numbers updated).
Trigger: more than 2 alive and it has already run from us once (boosted out of our line inside 170 m). Action: walk
in its view toward the crate cluster or drop; do not shoot. Exploited: limitation 7 (5.60 build: we must rate
above twice its strength, e.g. gun + laser with 10 cubes against its 0 cubes, at near full health; newer builds:
above 0.85 times, almost any equal mech). Gain: free loot. Backfire: none if we act only after seeing it flee.

**K6. Drop overwatch** (earlier C7).
Trigger: a supply drop within 200 m of a corner we hold, 25 s either side of landing. Action: watch the ring from
cover at 100-190 m, laser pre-charged off-axis; beam whoever stands in it for the 4 s capture. Exploited: limitation
9. Gain: two beams (630-944) and a magazine into a standing mech. Backfire: none; matches D6 (never contest).

**K7. Lightning dash from its 55 m hold** (needs our laser + lightning; earlier C5).
Trigger: two left or a lone pair, it shows gun + laser, keeps about 55 m from us, no lightning on it, our health 70%
or more and at least its fraction, energy 70+. Action: right after its beam, boost from 68 m to 43 m (it will not
start a charge while we close through 68-46 m), then lightning continuously (240 a second inside 45 m, shorts its
laser 2 s per hit); abort under 50% health, energy under 25 beyond 45 m, or a third mech aims at us. Exploited:
limitation 8 and its chaser rule. Gain: a kill in about 6 s for about 600 of our health. Backfire: high against a
brawler with lightning; bounded by the trigger.

**K8. Quiet-final corner** (f75kite-specific, rare).
Trigger: nobody has died by 20 s and it is in view. Until 75 s it answers only hits from inside 100 m; afterwards it
attacks any mech within 160 m at more than 60% health, holding 170 m and boosting back whenever we are inside
145 m, with laser caution and strength avoidance off. Action: before 75 s treat it as harmless beyond 100 m; after
75 s do not trade at 145-200 m in the open while it has more cubes; break its line and wait at a corner 60-100 m
from where it last saw us (it walks in to about 100 m with no laser caution), beam and gun as it rounds. Exploited:
limitation 10. Gain: a corner kill. Backfire: none in practice (house bots); the situation did not occur in any of
11 recorded showdowns.

**K9. Death-site watch** (only if a 07:05+ build becomes its entry).
Trigger: a mech died in our view within 180 m of a proj1-looking mech. Action: hold a corner 100-190 m from the
death spot with the laser pre-charged off-axis for 20 s; beam the mech that walks onto the spot. Exploited: the
death-site walk (7.2). Gain: a standing target picking up cubes. Backfire: we stay near a fight's survivor; apply
D11's third-party gate.

Not a counter: in practice matches nothing of this applies (house bots only).

## 10. Limitations of this study

- The 5.60 mapping rests on timing, on "submit the tip" and on benchmaster's 5.42 being `a53c31a` (itself
  "likely"); no statement by 2696 exists. The group's board (with official scores) has refused anonymous access
  since about 06:07, and was not re-checked (only `shaunkar1/proj1` was in scope).
- The free-for-all behaviour of the 5.60 build is read from code; no recording of it exists (the recordings show
  older builds and 2696's old bot).
- Scores of the 26 profile pins after 06:58 are unknown; benchmaster's 5.50 (07:21) and giddygiddyboy's 5.54
  (07:37) were not mapped (out of scope).
- The duel arithmetic of section 4 is a model on measured hit rates, not a measurement of this bot.
